            scale = math.sqrt((col + 1) * (col + 2))
            pos_basis[: col + 1, col] = 1.0 / scale
            pos_basis[col + 1, col] = -(col + 1) / scale
        with torch.no_grad():
            initialized_pos = self.pos_emb.weight.detach()

                (initialized_pos[:2], initialized_pos[-2:]), dim=0
            )
            compact_pos = torch.cat(
